001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010
011/**
012 * strings[i] &lt; strings[j] iff ints[i] &lt;= ints[j] strings[i] = strings[j]
013 * iff ints[i] = ints[j]
014 *
015 * 0 &lt; ints[i] &lt; |{ints}|
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropLexChainChannel extends Propagator<IntVar> {
020
021    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
022
023    private final IntVar[][] strings;
024    private final IntVar[] ints;
025
026    public PropLexChainChannel(IntVar[][] strings, IntVar[] ints) {
027        super(buildArray(strings, ints), PropagatorPriority.CUBIC, false);
028        this.strings = strings;
029        this.ints = ints;
030    }
031
032    private static IntVar[] buildArray(IntVar[][] strings, IntVar[] ints) {
033        if (strings.length != ints.length) {
034            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
035        }
036        IntVar[] array = new IntVar[strings.length * strings[0].length + ints.length];
037        System.arraycopy(ints, 0, array, 0, ints.length);
038        int i = ints.length;
039        for (IntVar[] string : strings) {
040            System.arraycopy(string, 0, array, i, string.length);
041            i += string.length;
042        }
043        assert i == array.length;
044        return array;
045    }
046
047    @Override
048    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
049        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
050    }
051
052    private static Ordering compareString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b) {
053        return compareString(a, b, 0);
054    }
055
056    private static Ordering compareString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b, int index) {
057        if (index == a.length) {
058            return a.length == b.length ? Ordering.EQ : Ordering.LT;
059        }
060        if (index == b.length) {
061            assert a.length != b.length;
062            return Ordering.GT;
063        }
064        Ordering ord = compare(a[index], b[index]);
065        switch (ord) {
066            case EQ:
067                return compareString(a, b, index + 1);
068            case LE:
069                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
070                    case LT:
071                        return Ordering.LT;
072                    case LE:
073                    case EQ:
074                        return Ordering.LE;
075                    default:
076                        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
077                }
078            case GE:
079                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
080                    case GT:
081                        return Ordering.GT;
082                    case GE:
083                    case EQ:
084                        return Ordering.GE;
085                    default:
086                        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
087                }
088            default:
089                return ord;
090        }
091    }
092
093    private static Ordering compare(IntVar a, IntVar b) {
094        int aLb = a.getLB();
095        int aUb = a.getUB();
096        int bLb = b.getLB();
097        int bUb = b.getUB();
098        if (aLb == bUb && aUb == bLb) {
099            return Ordering.EQ;
100        }
101        if (aLb > bUb) {
102            return Ordering.GT;
103        }
104        if (aLb >= bUb) {
105            return Ordering.GE;
106        }
107        if (aUb < bLb) {
108            return Ordering.LT;
109        }
110        if (aUb <= bLb) {
111            return Ordering.LE;
112        }
113        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
114    }
115
116    private boolean equalString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b) throws ContradictionException {
117        boolean changed = false;
118        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
119            changed |= equal(a[i], b[i]);
120        }
121        return changed;
122    }
123
124    private boolean equal(IntVar a, IntVar b) throws ContradictionException {
125        // Don't use short-circuit or
126        return a.updateLowerBound(b.getLB(), this)
127                | a.updateUpperBound(b.getUB(), this)
128                | b.updateLowerBound(a.getLB(), this)
129                | b.updateUpperBound(a.getUB(), this);
130    }
131
132    private boolean lessThanString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b) throws ContradictionException {
133        return lessThanString(a, b, 0);
134    }
135
136    private boolean lessThanString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b, int index) throws ContradictionException {
137        if (index == a.length) {
138            if (index == b.length) {
139                fails();
140            }
141            return false;
142        }
143        if (index == b.length) {
144            assert a.length != b.length;
145            fails();
146        }
147        switch (compare(a[index], b[index])) {
148            case EQ:
149                return lessThanString(a, b, index + 1);
150            case LT:
151                return false;
152            case GT:
153                fails();
154                return true;
155            case LE:
156            case GE:
157            case UNKNOWN:
158                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
159                    case EQ:
160                    case GT:
161                    case GE:
162                        return lessThan(a[index], b[index]);
163                    case LT:
164                    case LE:
165                    case UNKNOWN:
166                        return lessThanEqual(a[index], b[index]);
167                    default:
168                        throw new IllegalStateException();
169                }
170            default:
171                throw new IllegalStateException();
172        }
173    }
174
175    private boolean lessThan(IntVar a, IntVar b) throws ContradictionException {
176        // Don't use short-circuit or
177        return a.updateUpperBound(b.getUB() - 1, this)
178                | b.updateLowerBound(a.getLB() + 1, this);
179    }
180
181    private boolean lessThanEqualString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b) throws ContradictionException {
182        return lessThanEqualString(a, b, 0);
183    }
184
185    private boolean lessThanEqualString(IntVar[] a, IntVar[] b, int index) throws ContradictionException {
186        if (index == a.length) {
187            return false;
188        }
189        if (index == b.length) {
190            assert a.length != b.length;
191            fails();
192        }
193        switch (compare(a[index], b[index])) {
194            case EQ:
195                return lessThanEqualString(a, b, index + 1);
196            case LT:
197                return false;
198            case GT:
199                fails();
200                return true;
201            case LE:
202            case GE:
203            case UNKNOWN:
204                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
205                    case EQ:
206                    case LT:
207                    case LE:
208                    case GE:
209                    case UNKNOWN:
210                        return lessThanEqual(a[index], b[index]);
211                    case GT:
212                        return lessThan(a[index], b[index]);
213                    default:
214                        throw new IllegalStateException();
215                }
216            default:
217                throw new IllegalStateException();
218        }
219    }
220
221    private boolean lessThanEqual(IntVar a, IntVar b) throws ContradictionException {
222        // Don't use short-circuit or
223        return a.updateUpperBound(b.getUB(), this)
224                | b.updateLowerBound(a.getLB(), this);
225    }
226
227    private boolean propagateSmallest(boolean[] notSmallest, boolean notSmaller[], boolean[] lessThanEqual, int smallest) throws ContradictionException {
228        boolean changed = false;
229        boolean stop = true;
230        boolean lessThanEqualStop = false;
231        boolean[] notNextSmallest = new boolean[strings.length];
232        for (int i = 0; i < notSmallest.length; i++) {
233            if (!notSmallest[i]) {
234                notSmaller[i] = false;
235                stop = false;
236                lessThanEqualStop |= lessThanEqual[i];
237                changed |= ints[i].instantiateTo(smallest, this);
238            }
239            notNextSmallest[i] = !notSmaller[i];
240        }
241        if (stop || lessThanEqualStop) {
242            return changed;
243        }
244        for (int i = 0; i < strings.length; i++) {
245            if (notSmaller[i]) {
246                for (int j = i + 1; j < strings.length; j++) {
247                    if (notSmaller[j]) {
248                        Ordering ord = compareString(strings[i], strings[j]);
249                        switch (ord) {
250                            case LE:
251                                lessThanEqual[i] = true;
252                            // fallthrough
253                            case LT:
254                                notNextSmallest[j] = true;
255                                break;
256                            case GE:
257                                lessThanEqual[j] = true;
258                            // fallthrough
259                            case GT:
260                                notNextSmallest[i] = true;
261                                break;
262                            case UNKNOWN:
263                                notNextSmallest[i] = true;
264                                notNextSmallest[j] = true;
265                                break;
266                        }
267                    }
268                }
269            }
270        }
271        changed |= propagateSmallest(notNextSmallest, notSmaller, lessThanEqual, smallest + 1);
272        return changed;
273    }
274
275    // Idempotent.
276    private boolean propagateStrings() throws ContradictionException {
277        boolean changed = false;
278        boolean repeat;
279        do {
280            repeat = false;
281            int eqs = 0;
282            boolean[] notSmallest = new boolean[strings.length];
283            boolean[] lessThanEqual = new boolean[strings.length];
284            for (int i = 0; i < strings.length; i++) {
285                boolean equivalenceClass = false;
286                for (int j = i + 1; j < strings.length; j++) {
287                    Ordering ord = compareString(strings[i], strings[j]);
288                    switch (ord) {
289                        case EQ:
290                            repeat |= equal(ints[i], ints[j]);
291                            equivalenceClass = true;
292                            break;
293                        case LE:
294                            repeat |= lessThanEqual(ints[i], ints[j]);
295                            lessThanEqual[i] = true;
296                            notSmallest[j] = true;
297                            break;
298                        case LT:
299                            repeat |= lessThan(ints[i], ints[j]);
300                            notSmallest[j] = true;
301                            break;
302                        case GE:
303                            repeat |= lessThanEqual(ints[j], ints[i]);
304                            lessThanEqual[j] = true;
305                            notSmallest[i] = true;
306                            break;
307                        case GT:
308                            repeat |= lessThan(ints[j], ints[i]);
309                            notSmallest[i] = true;
310                            break;
311                        case UNKNOWN:
312                            notSmallest[i] = true;
313                            notSmallest[j] = true;
314                            break;
315                    }
316                }
317                if (equivalenceClass) {
318                    eqs++;
319                }
320            }
321            repeat |= propagateSmallest(notSmallest, notSmallest, lessThanEqual, 0);
322            for (IntVar var : ints) {
323                repeat |= var.updateUpperBound(ints.length - 1 - eqs, this);
324            }
325            changed |= repeat;
326        } while (repeat);
327        return changed;
328    }
329
330    // Idempotent.
331    private boolean propagateInts() throws ContradictionException {
332        boolean changed = false;
333        boolean repeat;
334        do {
335            repeat = false;
336            for (int i = 0; i < ints.length; i++) {
337                for (int j = i + 1; j < ints.length; j++) {
338                    switch (compare(ints[i], ints[j])) {
339                        case EQ:
340                            repeat |= equalString(strings[i], strings[j]);
341                            break;
342                        case LT:
343                            repeat |= lessThanString(strings[i], strings[j]);
344                            break;
345                        case LE:
346                            repeat |= lessThanEqualString(strings[i], strings[j]);
347                            break;
348                        case GT:
349                            repeat |= lessThanString(strings[j], strings[i]);
350                            break;
351                        case GE:
352                            repeat |= lessThanEqualString(strings[j], strings[i]);
353                            break;
354                    }
355                }
356            }
357            changed |= repeat;
358        } while (repeat);
359        return changed;
360    }
361
362    @Override
363    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
364        propagateStrings();
365        while (propagateInts() && propagateStrings());
366    }
367
368    @Override
369    public ESat isEntailed() {
370        boolean[] values = new boolean[ints.length];
371        for (int i = 0; i < strings.length; i++) {
372            for (int j = i + 1; j < strings.length; j++) {
373                Ordering intOrdering = compare(ints[i], ints[j]);
374                Ordering ord = compareString(strings[i], strings[j]);
375                if (intOrdering.contradicts(ord)) {
376                    return ESat.FALSE;
377                }
378            }
379            if (ints[i].isInstantiated()) {
380                int value = ints[i].getValue();
381                if (value < 0 || value >= values.length) {
382                    return ESat.FALSE;
383                }
384                values[value] = true;
385            }
386        }
387        if (isCompletelyInstantiated()) {
388            int i = 0;
389            while (i < values.length && values[i]) {
390                i++;
391            }
392            for (; i < values.length; i++) {
393                if (values[i]) {
394                    return ESat.FALSE;
395                }
396            }
397            return ESat.TRUE;
398        }
399        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
400    }
401
402    @Override
403    public String toString() {
404        return "lexChainChannel(" + Arrays.deepToString(strings) + ", " + Arrays.toString(ints) + ")";
405    }
406
407    private static enum Ordering {
408
409        EQ,
410        LT,
411        LE,
412        GT,
413        GE,
414        UNKNOWN;
415
416        boolean contradicts(Ordering ord) {
417            switch (this) {
418                case EQ:
419                    return LT.equals(ord) || GT.equals(ord);
420                case LT:
421                    return EQ.equals(ord) || GE.equals(ord) || GT.equals(ord);
422                case LE:
423                    return GT.equals(ord);
424                case GT:
425                    return EQ.equals(ord) || LE.equals(ord) || LT.equals(ord);
426                case GE:
427                    return LT.equals(ord);
428                case UNKNOWN:
429                    return false;
430                default:
431                    throw new IllegalStateException();
432            }
433        }
434    }
435}
